title: ui_logout
summary: Program.Logout.cs + LogoutUiLaw realize the whole arc: CMSG_LOGOUT_REQUEST on Logout/Exit, the SMSG_LOGOUT_RESPONSE decision table (reason!=0 refused with an error line and quit-disarm; instant silent awaiting completion; else a 20 s camp/quit countdown dialog), CMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL via ESC or Cancel with SMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL_ACK teardown, quit-only 'Exit now' force button, countdown expiry that only narrates (never manufactures completion), and SMSG_LOGOUT_COMPLETE either exiting the process (quit) or tearing down to character select. Menu sounds fire on request and dialog show/hide.
